verdict.rationale: Postman's own docs say the Postman CLI can run test collections in CI/CD pipelines, with configuration options and built-in reporters, and Newman is also documented for running collections from the command line. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that failed tests return a non-zero exit code to fail the build, regression-gating details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my API test collections in CI with a CLI and fail the build on regressions

citations.quote: You can also use the Postman CLI to run test collections as part of your continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline.
Run and manage collections with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters.
Newman allows you to run and test a Postman Collections directly from the command-line.
combine the Postman API with the Postman CLI to integrate Postman with your CI/CD workflow.
